in_marathi.name: Sharvaarav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Love, Peace, and Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvaarav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvaarav is a Sanskrit name which is derived from the words Sharva and Arav. Sharva is the name of the Hindu god of love, happiness, and fertility, while Arav is a synonym for the wind, symbolizing swiftness and victory. Therefore, Sharvaarav can be interpreted as the embodiment of love, peace, and victory.
